stories.headline: Anthropic Suspends Mythos Access Following Government Security Concerns
stories.body: Anthropic has disabled some access to its Fable 5 and Mythos 5 AI models. stories.headline: House Republicans rally around regional Fed banks
stories.body: Lawmakers from both parties defended regional Federal Reserve banks against potential consolidation, arguing local economic perspectives are essential to ensure monetary policy remains sound.
